alter PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE] AS
BEGIN

WITH CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(

	SELECT BaseAccountId, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount GROUP BY BaseAccountId 
)

, DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE AS (

-- UITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)   AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
from [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, BaseAccountId FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BaseAccountId) BCA ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BUB.BaseAccountId = BCA.BaseAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.BaseAccountId = CAP.BaseAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode


UNION ALL


-- NonUITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)  AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[NonUITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, BaseAccountId FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, BaseAccountId) BCA ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BUB.BaseAccountId = BCA.BaseAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.BaseAccountId = CAP.BaseAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
 BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.BalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode
)

INSERT INTO [DW].[FactTrustFundValue]

SELECT DISTINCT
 BusinessDateSK
 ,BranchSK
 ,BankSK
 ,AccountSK
 ,AccountId
 ,SUM(AUMAmountFull) AUMAmountFull
 ,SUM(AUMAmountProrated) AUMAmountProrated
 ,SourceSystemCode
 ,WorkFlowId
 ,TaskRunId
 ,InsertDttm
FROM DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE a
where not exists (
    select * from [DW].[FactTrustFundValue] b
    where 
    a.BusinessDateSK = b.BusinessDateSK
    and a.AccountId = b.AccountId   
)
GROUP BY
 BusinessDateSK
 ,BranchSK
 ,BankSK
 ,AccountSK
 ,AccountId
 ,SourceSystemCode
 ,WorkFlowId
 ,TaskRunId
 ,InsertDttm

END
GO
